chapter.verse: Tua khit a sawt lo-in khuapi khuata teng ah Jesu pai a, Pasian' kumpigam Lungdamna Thu tangko-in puak kawikawi hi.
Sawmlenihte zong amah tawh tonkhawm uh a, kha gilo veina leh cinatna pan damna a ngah numei kimkhat in zong zui uh hi. Tuate pen: a sung pan dawi sagih a kihawlkhia (Magdala khuami a kici) Mary,
Herod' innsung ulian Chuza ii zi Joanna, Susanna, leh amau' neihsa tawh Jesu a huh numei dang tampite ahi uh hi.
Mihonpi hong kikaikhawmin khua khatkhit khua khat pan mite hong pai uh ciangin Jesu in thugenteh khat gen a,
"Khaici vawhpa khat khaici vawh dingin kuankhia hi. Khaici a vawh ciangin kimkhat lam dungah tu a, khe tawh kisikzanin huihlak vasate in netum uh hi.
Kimkhat suangpi tungah tu a, a potoh ciangin leinom om lo ahih manin vulin keu hi.
Kimkhat lingbu lakah tu a, lingte hong khangin kungno depcip hi.
Kimkhat lei hoih ah tu a, poto-in a zah zakhat an piang hi," ci hi. Hih thute a gen kawmin Jesu in, "Zak nading bil a neite in za ta hen," ci-in kiko hi.
Nungzuite in hih thugenteh a khiatna a dot uh ciangin

Jesu in hih bangin dawng hi: "Pasian' kumpigam thuthukte theih nading thu note hong kipia khinzo a, ahi zongin midangte ahihleh, 'en-en napi a muh loh nadingun leh zaza napi a tel loh nadingun,' thugentehte bek tawh kipia hi.
"Tu-a thugenteh pen hih bang hi. Khaici pen Pasian' thu cihnopna hi.
Lam dung a tu khaici cihte pen thu a zate cihnopna hi a, a up loh nadingun leh hotkhiatna a ngah loh nadingun dawimangpa hong pai-in amaute' lungtang pan lakkhiatsak hi.
Suangpi tung a tute pen thu a zak uh ciangin nuamna tawh a sangte hi a, zung kha lo uh ahih manin tawmvei sung a up uh hangin zia-etna a tun ciangin puk uh hi.
Lingbu lak tu a cihte pen thu za napi nisim nuntakvai tawh kisai lunghihmawhna, mihaute eenna leh cilesa nopsakna cihte in a gakcipte hi a, a gah uh taksa zolo hi.
Lei hoih tunga tu a cihte pen thu a zak uh ciangin lungsim tak, lungsim hoih tawh a lenkipte hi a, lungduai-a thuakzawhna tawh gah nei uh hi.
"Kuamah in meivak a vak khit ciangin leibeel khuh lo-in lupna nuai-ah zong koih lo a, hong lut mite khuavak a muh nadingun meivaktau tungah koihzaw hi.
A hang pen lahkhiat loh dinga kiseelcip thu om lo a, a kitheikhia lo ding leh a kilangkhia lo ding thusim cih bang om lo hi.
Tua ahih manin thu na ngaih uh ciangin kidawm un. A hang pen a neite kipiabeh ding a, a neilote ahihleh nei a kisakte nangawn kilaksak ding hi."
Tu-in Jesu a nu leh a sanggamte hong pai uh a, ahi zongin mihonpi' huhau-in Jesu' kiang naih zolo uh hi.
Tua ciangin, "Na nu leh na sanggamte nang tawh kimu nuamin a pua-ah ding uh hi," ci-in Jesu' kiangah kigen hi.
Ahih hangin Jesu in, "Ka nu leh ka sanggamte cih pen Pasian' thu za-a a zuite ahi uh hi," ci hi.
Ni khat, Jesu a nungzuite tawh gunkuang sungah lutin amaute' kiangah, "Bual galkhat lamah va pai ni," ci hi. Tua ciangin pai uh a,
a pai laitakun Jesu ihmu hi. Tua laitak bual tungah huihpi hong kipeisuk a, gunkuang sung tui kivung ahih manin lauhuai mahmah hi.
Tua ciangin nungzuite pai-in Jesu phong uh a, "Topa aw, Topa aw, kote a si ding ka hita uh hi!" ci uh hi. Jesu zong khanglo-in huih leh tuihual kilokte a taai ciangin tuate khawl uh a, dai dide hi.

Tua ciangin amaute' kiangah, "Na upna uh koi ah om ahi hiam?" ci hi. Amaute zong lau-in lamdangsakna tawh khatlekhat kiho uh a, "Hih mipa, huih leh tui nangawn thupia-in tuate in a thu mang cih pen amah kua hi mawk ahi hiam?" ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in Galilee tawh kigalsaina Gerasa gam ah gunkuang hot uh hi.
Jesu tuinawl leitang a sik ciangin tua khua pan dawilawm nei mi khat in na dawntuah hi. Tua mipa pen puan a silh loh sawtvei khin a, inn ah teng lo-in han lakah om hi.
Jesu a muh ciangin amah kiko a, Jesu' mai-ah boksukin awging lianpi tawh, "Sangpenpa Pasian ii Tapa, Jesu aw, kei bang hong nuammawh na hi hiam? Kong thum hi, hong gawt kei in!" ci hi.

A hang pen Jesu in tua mipa' sungpan kha nin a pusuah nading thupia khinzo ahih man hi. (Tua mipa pen kha nin in mancip thei zel a, tamveipi hikhin hi. Khutkol leh khekol tawh a kikhih hinapi a kikhihnate peksat a, dawi in gamgawtak lakah kaikhia hi.)
Tua ciangin Jesu in, "Na min bang ahi hiam?" ci-in dong hi. Tua mipa a sungah dawi tampi lut khinzo ahih manin amah in, "Legion," ci-in dawng hi.
Tua ciangin leihawmpid sung pai dingin thu a piak loh nadingin Jesu' kiangah thum uh hi.
Tu-in mualpang ah vok honpikhat anne gamta-in om uh hi. Dawite in tua vokte' sungah lut a phal nadingin Jesu' tungah thum uh hi. Jesu in zong phalna pia hi.
Tua ciangin tua mipa' sungpan dawite pusuak uh a, vokte' sungah lut uh hi. Vok honte zong tuinawl kendang pan bual sung kikhawhsuk uh a, tummang uh hi.
Thupiang teng a muh uh ciangin vokcingte taimang uh a, khuapi sung leh khuakiim teng ah hih thupiang va genkhia uh hi.
Mite zong thupiang en dingin pusuak uh hi. Jesu kiangah pai uh a, dawite a paikhiatna mipa, puan silhin lungpilin Jesu' khe-phung ah a tu a muh uh ciangin lau mahmah uh hi.
Tua ciangin thupiang a mute in amaute' tungah dawilut mipa bangci bangin damsakna ngah cih thu gen uh hi.
Gerasa gam kimkot-a om mite a vekun launa tawh kidim uh ahih manin amaute' kiangpan Jesu a paikhiat nadingin thum uh hi. Tua hangin Jesu zong gunkuang sungah lutin ciah hi.
Dawite a paikhiatna mipa in Jesuh tawh kithuah dingin ngen a, ahi zongin Jesu in,

"Na inn ah ciah inla nang' ading Pasian in bangzahtak hong sepsak cih va genkhia in," ci-in sawl hi. Tua mipa zong paikhia-in ama' ading Jesu in bangzahtak sepsak cih thu khuapi bup mun citeng ah tangko hi.
Mihonpi in Jesu a na ngakcip uh ahih manin amah hong kilehkik ciangin lawptak na dawn uh hi.
Tua laitak vengkhawm ukte khat ahi Jairus minnei mi khat hong pai hi. Jesu' khe-phung ah boksuk a, a inn ah Jesu a lut nadingin thum hi.
A hang pen amah in tanu khat bek nei a, kum sawmlenih a pha tua a tanu a si ding hita hi. Jesu zong pai a, a kimkot ah mite kiphu ngeingai uh hi.
Tu-in kum sawmlenih tawntung siluang natna a vei numei khat om a, a neihsa khempeuh zato siampute' kiangah zangbei khin ahih hangin kuamah in damsak zolo hi.
Tua numei in Jesu' nung nehphei-in a puansilh khaukaie va lawng a, thakhat thu-in a siluang kang pah hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu in, "Kei hong lawng kua ahi hiam?" ci hi. Mi khempeuh in a nial ciangin Peter in, "Topa aw, mihonpi in nang hong uumcihin hong phu ngeingai hilo hiam?" ci hi.
Ahih hangin Jesu in, "Hong lawng khat om hi. A hang pen ka sung pan vangliatna pusuak cih ka phawkcian hi," ci hi.
Numei in amah kiseelcip zolo cih a telmuh ciangin liing kawmin hong pai-in Jesu' mai-ah boksuk a, Jesu a lawnna thu leh thakhat thu-in a damna thu mi khempeuh' mai-ah genkhia hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu in, "Tanu aw, na upna in nang hong damsak khin hi. Lungnuamin pai in," ci hi.
Tua bangin thu a gen laitak vengkhawm ukpa' inn pan mi khat hong pai-in, "Na tanu si ta hi. Syapa konlawh nawn dah in," ci hi.
Himah taleh hih thu a zak ciangin Jesu in, "Lau kei inla um bek lel in; na tanu hong dam ding hi," ci hi.
Tua inn a tun ciangin Jesu in kuamah dang phal lo-in Peter, John, James leh numeino' nulehpa bek lutpih hi.
Numeino' hangin mi khempeuh kapin thumin om uh a, ahi zongin Jesu in, "Kap kei un. A hang pen amah si lo-in a ihmu hi bek hi," ci hi.
Mite in numeino si ahihlam thei uh ahih manin Jesu nuihsan uh hi.
Ahih hangin Jesu in numeino a khut tawh lenin, "Numeino aw, tho in," ci hi.
Tua ciangin numeino a kha hong kilehkik ahih manin thakhat thu-in thoto pah hi. Jesu in nektheih khatpeuh numeino a piak nadingun sawl hi.
A nu leh a pa in lamdang sa mahmah uh a, ahih hangin Jesu in thupiang teng kuamah' kiangah gen loh dingin amaute vaikhak hi.Sawmlenihte Sawlkhiatna
